title: Parsing an Encoded Algebraic Gate
statement: Fix $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Encode a variable $x_i$ by the tag $000$ followed by the unary encoding of $i$, the constant $1$ by $001$, and addition, subtraction, and multiplication by the tags $010$, $011$, and $100$, respectively, each followed by the unary encodings of its two node indices. Let the parser read these tags and encodings, accepting a variable only when its index is less than $n$; then for every algebraic gate $g$ on $n$ inputs and every Boolean string $r$, parsing the encoding of $g$ followed by $r$ returns $g$ and leaves $r$ unconsumed.
